links.outcome: LLM answer accuracy against cardiologist ground truth on echocardiogram report questions
links.effect: LLM correctly answered 90% of questions: 83% temporality, 93% severity assessment, 84% intervention identification, 100% diagnosis retrieval.
links.quote: The LLM correctly answered 90% questions, with accuracies of 83% for temporality, 93% for severity assessment, 84% for intervention identification, and 100% for diagnosis retrieval.

links.outcome: LLM output accuracy evaluated against ground-truth answers created by faculty cardiologists
links.effect: Model answers assessed against cardiologist-created ground truth; 90% correct across 100 question-answer pairs, with errors from misinterpreting numbers or hallucinations.
links.quote: The model's performance was evaluated against ground-truth answers created by faculty cardiologists.

unlisted_practices: Running a local open-source LLM with retrieval over a patient's longitudinal report history to preserve privacy

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of a local open-source LLM (LLaMA-2 70B) paired with retrieval to answer clinician queries on retrospective echocardiogram reports against expert cardiologist ground truth, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
